audit.overallVerdict: The menu kit is genuinely well built and, unusually, honestly reported — but the audit found one real contract breach, one real verification hole, and the product step still missing. (1) Wave 0 never delivered what the design contract ordered: MENU-KIT-DESIGN.md §3.1/§5 requires widening DropdownMenuContent/TooltipContent Picks with "anchor" | "container" | "collisionPadding"; the shipped diff gives dropdown-menu anchor+collisionPadding and tooltip anchor only — no `container` anywhere — so ChromeBar/ToolDock/SplitButton/DraftBar dropdowns always portal to document.body and a host's token-scoped `container` (host contract §4, "Universal") is silently ignored for most popups. Lane I flagged it; nobody fixed it at any barrier even though the file was wave-0's own write set. (2) The GATE RESULTS verified only the storybook vitest project: their file/test counts match story files exactly, and vitest.config.ts's `test-stories` deliberately excludes the `unit` project — so the 22 ported acceptance suites (314 tests, including the design-mandated 4,608-case placement differential) were never executed by any gate, while every lane deferred to "the orchestrator's barrier" as its first real verification. I ran everything independently in /home/bam/bbox-ui/.claude/worktrees/component-docs-reorganize-bf287b/apps/storybook-basics: typecheck clean, 56/294 story tests pass, 22/314 unit tests pass — so no latent code failure, but the verification claim was hollow. (3) Lane N (registry.json items) never ran; per CLAUDE.md "the registry is the product," none of the ~45 new files is consumable yet. Beyond that: the import law holds perfectly across all 47 files (zero engine imports, zero self-measurement/localStorage/position:fixed; the only z-index is framesPanel's dnd-kit drag row, matching trunk precedent portEdge.tsx:767 but contradicting the design's letter), provenance spot-checks hit cited donor lines 12-for-12 on substance (three stale line counts), all four named WHYs survived verbatim, and stories are real measured galleries. Recommended order: widen `container` (+ tooltip collisionPadding) in wave-0's two files, wire the unit project into the gate, then run Lane N.
lawViolations: apps/storybook-basics/src/components/framesPanel.tsx:401 — `zIndex: isDragging ? 10 : undefined` on the sortable row, plus internal dnd-kit (PointerSensor attaches document-level listeners during an active drag). Violates the design's L3 ban on z-index/global listeners as written; matches existing trunk precedent (portEdge.tsx:767 `zIndex: isDragging ? 10 : 1`, blockMembers.tsx dnd-kit) and the lane brief's explicit instruction to match it.
